annotations.label: SplashReveal
annotations.comment: Original spaceship/planet background reveal, without SUN DOG logo; copies bitmap source = HGR destination + $2400. No p-code is involved. REA ev_51ca2df4d888134ce1cd657612ad428abb24719ec6ba9280940d9ed59c2a72ff.

annotations.label: SplashCenterSeed
annotations.comment: Four center writes: rows95/96 and byte columns19/20.

annotations.label: SplashExpandIteration
annotations.comment: 19 iterations. Initial L18 R21 T90 B101; each iteration L-- R++ T-=5 B+=5.

annotations.label: SplashTopFiveRows
annotations.comment: Increasing columns; five ascending rows per column. Source pointers are corresponding HGR pointers + $2400.

annotations.label: SplashRightEdge
annotations.comment: Right byte column; ascending rows top through bottom, inclusive.

annotations.label: SplashBottomFiveRows
annotations.comment: Decreasing columns; five descending rows per column.

annotations.label: SplashLeftEdge
annotations.comment: Left byte column; descending rows bottom through top+1. Top row is excluded here.

annotations.label: SplashExpandBounds
annotations.comment: Expand bounds by one byte horizontally and five rows vertically; count19 ends at columns0/39, rows0/191.

annotations.label: SplashReturn
annotations.comment: RTS returns to bootstrap0867 for the observed JSR0864 path; runtime/Language Card loads follow the picture.

annotations.label: SplashHGRAddress
annotations.comment: A=byte column, X=row. Returns HGR page1 address in zp18/19. Verified row tables and all192 rows. REA ev_d1836c939bcb0c2c50178c38f60aac98adaf1db2dda742bbcde0a90b2e41f851.
